effect.bookofe.rend.desc: Inflicts stacking bleeding damage over time.
item.bookofe.worm_hammer.passive.desc: Every 3rd hit triggers a shockwave that damages nearby foes.
item.bookofe.worm_hammer.ability.desc: Slam the ground after burrowing forward, erupting rock and damaging enemies.
item.bookofe.moon_sword.passive.desc: Your attacks grow stronger under moonlight. +20% damage at night or in open sky with moon visible.
item.bookofe.moon_sword.ability.desc: Sneak + Right-click to call down a beam of moonlight on a 3×3 area. Damages undead heavily and blinds all mobs caught in it. 12s cooldown.
item.bookofe.beach_blade.ability.desc: Dash forward in a watery surge, damaging enemies along the path.
item.bookofe.the_black_blade.passive.des: Chance to deal true damage and inflict wither on hit.
item.bookofe.calamityblade.passive.desc: Hits apply Rend (bleed) for 4s, stacking up to 5. Using abilities triggers stored bleed for bonus damage.
item.bookofe.calamityblade.ability.desc: Right-click while looking at a mob within 20 blocks to cleave it, dealing massive damage. Triggers stored bleed instantly. 4s cooldown.
item.bookofe.slime_hammer.passive.desc: 20% chance to absorb 20-30% of incoming damage with a boing sound.
item.bookofe.slime_hammer.ability.desc: Right-click to spawn 2-3 slime buddies for 5 seconds. 12s cooldown.
advancement.bookofe.intro.title: The Book Opens
advancement.bookofe.intro.description: Begin your journey into the Book of E
advancement.bookofe.discover_shrine.desc: Discover a mysterious shrine hidden in the wilderness
advancement.bookofe.root.title: Book of E
advancement.bookofe.root.description: The beginning of a dark journey
advancement.bookofe.root.welcome: Welcome to the Book of E! Check your advancements for new challenges.
advancement.bookofe.kill_joe_rebel.title: Rebel's End
ritual.bookofe.chaos_summoner: The void trembles... Chaos answers the call.
ritual.bookofe.crimson_knight: The crimson seal awakens... Valor rises from the altar.
ritual.bookofe.golden_king: A divine light descends... The golden king stirs.
ritual.bookofe.shadow_rebel: Darkness coalesces... The shadow rebel emerges.
ritual.bookofe.fallen_shadow: The obsidian weeps... The fallen shadow awakens.
ritual.bookofe.slime_king: The goo pulses with life... The slime king materializes.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_nicky.desc: Used to summon Nicky, Sassy Summoner at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_eli.desc: Used to summon King Hajile at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_milly.desc: Used to summon Milly, Knight Commander at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_joe.desc: Used to summon Joe, Rebel Leader at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.cult_altar.desc: A mystical altar used to summon powerful bosses. Place a summoning key on the altar to begin the ritual.
jei.bookofe.worm_hammer.desc: A powerful hammer that triggers shockwaves. Every 3rd hit causes Tremor Hit. Right-click to use Burrow Slam ability.
jei.bookofe.slime_hammer.desc: A gooey hammer with defensive properties. 20% chance to absorb damage. Right-click to spawn slime allies.
jei.bookofe.moon_sword.desc: A blade that grows stronger under moonlight. +20% damage at night. Right-click while sneaking to use Moonfall ability.
jei.bookofe.beach_blade.desc: A watery blade that allows dashing through enemies. Right-click to use Tidal Dash ability.
jei.bookofe.blackborn.desc: A cursed blade with a chance to deal true damage and inflict wither on hit.
jei.bookofe.calamity.desc: A devastating blade that applies Rend (bleed) on hit. Right-click to use Cleave ability, which triggers all stored bleed damage.
